description: CodePipeline deploy stage failed — ECS task killed due to OOM
resolution: Increased ECS task definition memory from 512MB to 1024MB. Updated service to use new task definition revision.

description: ECS container OOM killed during deployment, pipeline rolled back
resolution: Increased memory limit to 1024MB in task definition. Root cause: new dependency increased baseline memory usage.

description: Glue job daily_claims_load failed with JDBC connection timeout to Redshift
resolution: Increased JDBC connection timeout from 30s to 120s. Added retry logic with exponential backoff. Verified Redshift WLM queue not saturated.

description: Glue connection timeout again on claims load job
resolution: Connection timeout recurred. Moved Glue job to dedicated Redshift WLM queue with guaranteed concurrency. Timeout resolved.

description: Tableau dashboard showing yesterday's data, not refreshing
resolution: Tableau extract schedule was set to 6AM but Glue job completes at 6:30AM. Moved extract to 7AM. Data now fresh by SLA.

description: EC2 instance i-0abc123def unreachable, system status check failed
resolution: Underlying hardware issue. Stopped and started instance to migrate to new host. Verified application recovered. Added auto-recovery alarm.

description: EBS volume /dev/xvda at 95% on prod-api-server
resolution: Cleaned old logs (35GB in /var/log/app). Extended EBS from 50GB to 100GB. Added logrotate config and CloudWatch disk alarm at 80%.

description: Disk full again on prod-api-server, logs consuming all space
resolution: Logrotate was not applied to new log path /var/log/app/audit/. Added rotation config. Shipped logs to CloudWatch Logs to prevent local accumulation.

description: Lambda function claims-processor can't write to S3 bucket prod-reports
resolution: Lambda execution role missing s3:PutObject permission. Added inline policy scoped to prod-reports/claims/* with KMS encryption condition.

description: Cross-account role assumption failing from data pipeline account
resolution: Trust policy on target role did not include source account principal. Updated trust policy with specific role ARN and ExternalId condition.

description: API Gateway returning 503, ALB health checks failing on backend
resolution: Security group on backend ECS tasks missing inbound rule for port 8080 from ALB security group. Added rule. Health checks passed within 30s.

description: New microservice can't be reached through ALB, getting 503
resolution: Same pattern as TKT-HIST0011. New service deployed without adding SG rule for ALB. Added inbound rule from ALB SG on service port.

description: CodeBuild project timing out after 60 minutes on integration tests
resolution: Increased build timeout to 120 minutes. Added dependency caching for node_modules. Parallelized test suites. Build now completes in 35 minutes.

description: Glue crawler not detecting new partitions in S3 data lake
resolution: Crawler exclusion pattern was too broad, filtering out new date partitions. Updated exclusion regex. Ran MSCK REPAIR TABLE to backfill.

description: Lambda cold start causing API timeout for claims submission endpoint
resolution: Enabled provisioned concurrency (5 instances) for claims-submission Lambda. Cold start eliminated. Also reduced package size by removing unused dependencies.

description: Duplicate records appearing in fact_claims table after ETL run
resolution: Merge statement missing composite key (claim_id + service_date). Added dedup step in staging. Cleaned duplicates from target. Added DQ rule to prevent recurrence.

description: VPN connection dropping intermittently for remote developers
resolution: Client VPN endpoint had DPD timeout set too low (10s). Increased to 30s. Also added second tunnel for redundancy.

description: RDS PostgreSQL connections exhausted, application getting connection refused
resolution: max_connections at limit (100). Application not releasing connections properly. Added PgBouncer as connection pooler. Increased RDS instance to db.r5.large (max_connections=500).

description: Terraform apply failing with state lock timeout
resolution: Previous apply was interrupted, leaving stale lock in DynamoDB. Force-unlocked state: terraform force-unlock <lock-id>. Added pipeline step to detect stale locks.

description: CloudWatch alarm firing for high CPU on batch processing instances
resolution: Batch job running during peak hours competing with API workload. Moved batch to off-peak schedule (2AM-5AM). Adjusted ASG to scale based on queue depth instead of CPU.

description: Schema change in upstream source broke Glue job — new column added
resolution: Upstream added nullable column 'middle_name'. Glue job strict schema validation failed. Enabled schema evolution with ResolveChoice. Added schema change detection alert.

description: Another upstream schema change broke ETL — new field added without notice
resolution: Same pattern as TKT-HIST0021. Applied schema evolution handling. Added upstream schema contract validation to catch changes before they break pipelines.

description: SQS dead letter queue filling up, messages not being processed
resolution: Lambda consumer hitting concurrency limit (10). Messages timing out and going to DLQ. Increased reserved concurrency to 50. Added DLQ alarm at 100 messages.

description: KMS decrypt permission denied when Lambda tries to read from encrypted S3 bucket
resolution: KMS key policy did not grant kms:Decrypt to Lambda execution role. Added key policy statement allowing decrypt for the specific role ARN.

description: NAT Gateway bandwidth throttling causing Lambda timeouts in private subnet
resolution: Single NAT Gateway saturated at 45Gbps during batch processing. Added second NAT Gateway in different AZ. Updated route tables for multi-AZ NAT.
